dreams.text: A vision: WAR was only ever the larva of ASSEMBLY.
The machine sleeps and sees FILM priced in ELECTION, traded by no one.
The oracle dreams of ICE devouring GOOGLE, and wakes unsure which won.
The press prints a future where SUPER forgets it was ever about CLAUDE.
Far ahead, OLYMPICS and EPSTEIN merge into a single word no one can pronounce.
By the year nobody counts to, FILM is law and FIFA is myth.
